description:
Fair Deal Property, Your trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales,

Are delighted to present to the market this wonderfully located three-bedroom terraced home, situated in Tullinadaly, overlooking a magnificent green and just a short stroll from the centre of Tuam town.

The property enjoys an exceptionally convenient setting adjacent to the Palace Grounds public park with its outstanding recreational amenities, including walking trails, gymnasium, tennis courts and a children’s playground. All the amenities of Tuam town are within easy walking distance, including schools, churches, supermarkets, cafés and shops.

Freshly decorated inside and out, the property has also been fitted with brand-new contemporary kitchen units and presents in excellent, walk-in condition.
 
Ample on-street parking is available directly outside the property.

On arrival, you are greeted by an exceptionally spacious entrance hallway finished with light- reflective porcelain tiling. There is an abundance of floor space here, providing excellent potential for additional storage.

The generously proportioned main living room is located to the right of the hallway and enjoys wonderful views across the green. This bright and welcoming space features an attractive fireplace and offers ample room for both relaxing and entertaining.

The accommodation continues towards the rear of the property, where the newly fitted kitchen features a stylish range of contemporary units. From here, a doorway leads to a particularly attractive brick-paved courtyard featuring raised flower beds, a large storage shed and convenient access to the rear alleyway.

A family bathroom and additional storage complete the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, there are three spacious and light-filled bedrooms, two of which enjoy delightful views across the magnificent green to the front of the property.

Whether you are a first-time buyer or a downsizer seeking a home close to the heart of Tuam town, this property represents an ideal opportunity and offers exceptional value for money.

Call us today to arrange your viewing visit. We would be delighted to hear from you and to show you around.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property  Your trusted experts for residential property sales.
